note: Evil Mode: the eight Doctrines (design Part 4 section 2; Kanto pools from section 4.1). Kits, perks and weaknesses take effect from slice 2 on.

doctrines.name: Swarm
doctrines.home: Towns; roads; anywhere with a crowd
doctrines.says: I've got three! They're not very good! There's three, though!

doctrines.name: Bruisers
doctrines.line: We only need to hit it once.
doctrines.perk: Grunt aces are +1 level; Outplay odds +10%.
doctrines.says: It's not complicated. I like that it's not complicated.

doctrines.name: Tricksters
doctrines.line: You'll not see how it was done.
doctrines.perk: A failed dispatch costs half the Heat; Take odds +10%.
doctrines.weakness: A lead that can't be put to sleep.
doctrines.says: I'd tell you how I got in, but then you'd know.

doctrines.name: Beasts
doctrines.perk: Cheap to hire (wages -₽50); Loyalty swings twice as far, both ways.
doctrines.home: Farmland; moors; wild ground of any kind
doctrines.says: He's not got a Ball. He just comes.

doctrines.name: Machines
doctrines.line: It does what it's built to.
doctrines.perk: Rooms build a day faster; base puzzle pieces cost half.
doctrines.home: Power plants; factories; rail yards; anywhere urban
doctrines.says: It's doing what I told it. I should've told it something else.

doctrines.name: Ghosts
doctrines.says: I don't have her. She has me. It's an arrangement.

doctrines.name: Tide
doctrines.line: Everything comes down to the water in the end.
doctrines.perk: Sea and river holdings count double toward a district.
doctrines.home: Coasts; rivers; ports; anything by the water
doctrines.says: Can we do this by the harbour? He's better by the harbour.

doctrines.name: Ember
doctrines.line: Dig down far enough and it's warm.
doctrines.perk: Digs and labs pay +20%; Digs take a day less.
doctrines.home: Volcanoes; deserts; quarries; anything hot or underground
